description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Upgrade_Util_Job, which contains utility methods for managing upgrade jobs, including saving job results, checking installation steps, and logging errors within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OX_Upgrade_Util_Job
classes.description: Contains static utility methods for managing upgrade jobs, including saving results, verifying installation steps, and logging errors.

methods.name: saveJobResult
methods.description: Stores the result of a job into session storage, keyed by job type and name.

methods.name: isInstallerStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if a specific installation step has been completed during an install or upgrade process.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message related to a job result, initializing the logger if necessary.
